ios.desc:
Percento focuses on what matters - your assets and investments, not every coffee purchase.

Featured as one of Apple's "Top 10 Finance Apps We Love"

WHY USERS LOVE PERCENTO

"I don't keep accounts, now I developed the habit of keeping accounts" - User
"I love opening the app and seeing my net worth grow" - User Review
"Assets and liabilities at a glance" - User Review
"Professional and convenient" - iFanr, AppSo
"Very beautiful! I love the UI in a heartbeat!" - User

FEATURES

◎ A refreshing workflow to keep track of your wealth
◎ Automatic updates global stocks and cryptocurrencies prices
◎ Multi-currency support with automatic currency rates sync
◎ Beautiful and focused charts to help you make investment decisions
◎ Manage asset mix with Account Group
◎ Double entry transfer between accounts
◎ Curated animations and themes
◎ Sync your data across iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple Silicon

Questions? We'd love to hear from you: hi@percento.app

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Privacy Policy: https://www.percento.app/wiki/privacy
